verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no natural-language command interface for Stripe Identity, such as a built-in assistant or a prompt-driven console. The only related item is Stripe's general MCP server, which gives external AI agents API tools. That is a separate MCP-server capability, relies on a third-party agent to interpret language, and is not shown to cover Identity endpoints, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
